recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, cinematic photograph of a woman with voluminous dark hair lounging in a vintage white convertible with red accents, framed by a thick black border and featuring stark white sans-serif and script typography in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the car's interior leads the eye from the bottom left to the top right.
The subject's black dress and fishnets provide a sharp textural contrast against the smooth white leather seats.
The vibrant red car door in the foreground acts as a saturated color anchor for the composition.
The white typography is placed in the darkest area of the upper right to maximize legibility.
coreInvariants: Thick black outer border framing the square image.
High-angle perspective looking down into the vehicle.
Subject wearing black evening wear with white opera gloves.
Combination of heavy sans-serif and light script lettering.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered but oriented diagonally, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red car panel in the lower-left foreground provides a heavy, saturated starting point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the red foreground, along the subject's legs, up to her face, and finally to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The black border and the dark dashboard area provide breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and cream tones of the car interior and gloves.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the dress, hair, and outer border.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Candy-apple red of the car exterior and the subject's lipstick.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white leather and black clothing; high saturation in the red accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, white, black, and neutral skin tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of ultra-condensed sans-serif and a casual, hand-drawn monoline script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses uniform stroke weight and tight kerning.
Secondary text uses a thin, slanted script with open loops.
All text is rendered in pure white.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the sans-serif is extremely narrow.
The script text uses quotation marks that match the stroke weight of the letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a heavy, rigid block font and a light, fluid script.
graphicDevices: Small 'Stereo' badge in bottom left corner with wave icons

preserve: Condensed nature of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, bold sans-serif profile.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph a woman with 80s-style dark hair in a black dress and white gloves sitting in a white vintage convertible. Use a high-angle shot. Ensure a bright red car panel is in the lower-left foreground. Frame the entire image with a thick black square border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the top right using an ultra-condensed bold white sans-serif. Directly below, add the subtitle in a thin white monoline script, slightly tilted upwards.

verificationChecks: Is the border a consistent thick black frame?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper quadrant?
Does the red foreground panel create a strong diagonal?
Are the gloves and car interior a matching bright white?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any logos or brand emblems on the car
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Ensure the fishnet texture is sharp and visible.
Verify the red color is vibrant and not orange-leaning.
Confirm the black border is perfectly square.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-angle photography + vintage car + black/white/red palette + condensed sans-serif/script pairing + thick black frame.
